title: Secure oncologist + patient-advocate reviewer panel
context: Patient-facing explainers are riskTier:high and gated: they cannot start until an oncologist + patient-advocate reviewer panel is secured and the "not medical advice" framing is ratified. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Education only -- never advice; this task secures the blocking review panel.
objective: Secure and document a named oncologist + patient-advocate reviewer panel and ratify the 'not medical advice' framing as the precondition for any patient-facing work.
acceptanceCriteria: A named oncologist and a named patient-advocate reviewer are secured (or explicitly marked TO BE SECURED), with their qualifications recorded.
The panel's sign-off responsibility is documented: no patient-facing explainer ships without recorded oncologist + advocate sign-off (riskTier: high hard gate).
The 'not medical advice' framing/banner is ratified and recorded; education-only scope (no clinical/treatment/prognostic guidance) is stated.
PLAN.md Governance reflects the panel (or TO BE SECURED status) and the appointment is dated; no explainer task may start until filled.
